decisions.label: Tumor Tissue Sample
decisions.description: Tissue sample that contains an abnormal cellular infiltrate forming a solid mass.

verification.note: NCIT:C18009 Tumor Tissue Sample; label adds 'Tissue Sample' qualifier but correctly describes a tumor-derived biospecimen as opposed to a Normal tissue sample (NCIT:C162623 for 'Normal'). Best available NCIT match for the tumor biospecimen status value.

decisions.label: Normal Tissue Sample
decisions.description: Tissue sample with cellular composition and architectural patterns expected for the particular anatomic site in which it belongs. There is no evidence of abnormal cellular infiltrates or tumor mass formation.

verification.note: NCIT:C162623 Normal Tissue Sample; matches the specimen-status sense of Normal (non-tumor tissue).

decisions.label: Not Reported
decisions.description: An indication that the required information was not provided.

verification.note: NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard CDISC/NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Peritumoral
decisions.description: Located in tissues surrounding a tumor.

verification.note: NCIT:C119010 Peritumoral; exact label and definition match for tissue surrounding a tumor.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.
